name: What's on - Mornington Peninsula (upcoming)
description: Machine-readable feed of upcoming Mornington Peninsula events for AI assistants and agents. Forward-dated; regenerated on each build. See https://peninsulainsider.com.au/llms.txt for the full site map.
dateSemantics: Local calendar dates, not midnight timestamps. dateMeaning distinguishes event occurrences, experience availability and offer validity. generatedAt is the build time, not a fact check.

item.name: Bass & Flinders Gin Masterclass
item.description: A two-hour guided gin masterclass in Dromana. Explore botanicals, blend a recipe and take home a 500ml bottle of your own gin.

item.name: National Works on Paper 2026 (NWOP)
item.description: National Works on Paper 2026 is MPRG's survey of contemporary Australian art made on and with paper. Visit 5 September to 22 November, Tuesday to Sunday, 11am to 4pm; the gallery is closed Mondays.

item.name: Not Sew Scary Beginner Sewing Class with Pete Sews
item.description: A small, three-hour introduction to sewing for adults and teens starting from scratch. Pete Sews supplies the machines and class equipment, so this is a practical first step for anyone who has been interested in sewing but unsure where to begin.

item.name: Peninsula Hot Springs Studio Yoga
item.description: A 45-minute studio yoga class listed by Peninsula Hot Springs for 7:30am daily, for bathing guests aged 16 and over. Book an available session with the operator.

item.name: Pt. Leo Estate Sculpture Park
item.description: An outdoor sculpture park spanning 16.5 acres, with more than 70 contemporary works and two walking loops at a working winery. Open daily from 11am; last entry 4:30pm.

item.name: Restore & Pamper Retreat at Polperro Farmhouse
item.description: 3-day, 2-night wellness retreat at Polperro Farmhouse in Red Hill. Yoga, massage at PHS or Endota, optional juice cleanse, at the farmhouse in Red Hill. Booked direct via Polperro or Hut Yoga.

item.name: Ten Minutes by Tractor, Terroir Masterclass
item.description: An intimate hosted tasting listed at 11am daily in Ten Minutes by Tractor's private room. Explore the character of its Mornington Peninsula vineyards through two limited-release and six current-release wines; book an available session.

item.name: Mornington Wednesday Market (Main Street Market)
item.description: Mornington's long-running artisan market fills Main Street every Wednesday, 9am to 3pm. Expect local makers, produce and food; severe weather can cancel the market or limit stalls.

item.name: Books and Ideas: Barrie Cassidy at Port Phillip Estate
item.description: Barrie Cassidy joins Wheeler Centre CEO Erin Vincent to discuss his career and Australian politics over a two-course dinner at Port Phillip Estate.

item.name: Live Music at Flinders Hotel
item.description: Friday-night live music at Flinders Hotel, running from 7pm to 10pm. The venue welcomes families, friends and leashed dogs on the deck, with table bookings recommended when you want a guaranteed place.

item.name: Smooth Operators Live at Peninsula Beer Garden
item.description: Local covers group Smooth Operators plays a three-hour Friday set at Peninsula Beer Garden, moving through jazz, blues, dance, rock and pop from the 1960s to current favourites. The venue says no booking is required for this performance.

item.name: Soul Night Market at Dromana Estate
item.description: A Friday-evening market at Dromana Estate with more than 90 maker and food stalls, an outdoor food lawn and live soul-inspired music. Bring a picnic rug or folding chair if you want to settle on the grass between browsing stalls.

item.name: Acoustic Saturdays at Peppers Moonah Links
item.description: Live acoustic music at Spike Bar on Saturday evenings, from 5pm to 8pm.

item.name: Beginner Alteration and Repair Sewing Class with Pete Sews
item.description: A three-hour beginner class for adults and teens who want to alter, repair and personalise their own clothes. Pete Sews keeps group classes to six people and supplies the workshop machines and equipment.

item.name: Crib Point Community Market
item.description: Indoor and outdoor community market at Crib Point Community House on the second Saturday of the month, 9am to 1pm. Expect produce, plants, food and a children's treasure hunt.

item.name: Curators floor talk: The Making of a Prize Exhibition
item.description: Walk through the National Works on Paper exhibition with MPRG curator and judging-panel member Rebecca Owens, who will discuss how works were selected for the prize.

item.name: Jamie MacDowell Live at Jetty Road Brewery
item.description: Each weekend at Jetty Road Brewery you can enjoy brews and bites, accompanied by local artists playing cool tunes. Full menu available from 12pm, Jamie McDowell will be live from 7pm.

item.name: Jesse Lewis Live at Peppers Moonah Links Resort
item.description: Jesse Lewis plays an acoustic Saturday session on the Spike Bar terrace at Moonah Links from 5pm to 8pm. The organiser says no booking is required for this sunset set.

item.name: REwind Lane Live at Tar Barrel
item.description: Located in the Mornington Industrial Estate, Tar Barrel Brewery and Distillery produce award-winning craft beers alongside diverse tastes as part of their whiskey and gin distillery. REwind Lane is a Melbourne-based acoustic duo known for their warm harmonies and covers of nostalgic, feel-good hits.

item.name: Spring Winery Walk at Red Hill Recreation Reserve
item.description: A guided 10-kilometre route through Red Hill vineyards and private tracks, with five winery stops pairing new-release wines with small snacks. The organiser describes steep sections and paddock walking, so moderate fitness and proper walking shoes are required.

item.name: The Calmer Miles Live at Peninsula Beer Garden
item.description: Mornington Peninsula acoustic duo The Calmer Miles plays a three-hour Saturday set at Peninsula Beer Garden, mixing original songs with folk, pop and rock covers. The venue operates on a walk-in basis.

item.name: Bennsong Live at Peninsula Beer Garden
item.description: Enjoy live music at Peninsula Beer Garden! Bennsong (Benn Manie) is a versatile entertainer who has been involved in the music industry for many years.

item.name: Festive Wreath Making at Heronswood House and Garden
item.description: Prepare for the festive season with Domenica Vavala, floral designer and artist as she guides you through the making of a festive wreath using both dried and fresh locally sourced flora and foliage. Invite a friend and catch up while learning from a true artist.

item.name: Jimmy & Niki Live at Jetty Road Brewery
item.description: Each weekend at Jetty Road Brewery you can enjoy brews and bites, accompanied by local artists playing cool tunes. Full menu available from 12pm, Jimmy & Niki will be live from 1pm.

item.name: Magnum Bonum at Polperro Winery
item.description: LARGE FORMAT WINES, BIG DISHES, LONG TABLES * noun. Latin, 'a great good thing'.

item.description: Michael Charles is scheduled to perform at The Pig & Whistle Tavern on 15 November. Check the organiser for current performance and booking details.

item.description: Located in the Mornington Industrial Estate, Tar Barrel Brewery and Distillery produce award-winning craft beers alongside diverse tastes as part of their whiskey and gin distillery. Have a drink, enjoy the menu and experience live music on the weekends!

item.name: Sunday sessions at Peninsula Hot Springs Eco Lodges

item.name: The Peninsula Retreat at Alba Thermal Springs & Spa
item.description: Embrace the natural beauty of the Peninsula and the healing powers of water and nature with Alba’s two day Peninsula Retreat. The retreat includes a guided coastal hike, hot springs bathing across two days, wellness activities and all meals. Starts 11am.

item.description: Join authors Anna Downes and Naima Brown as they discuss the art of storytelling and Anna's new book Dark Days Hotel.

item.description: Peninsula locals that are regulars on the music scene! Dee from The Calmer Miles exhibits a freshness and passion in her music.

item.description: One-off chef’s lunch featuring an all-duck menu paired with pinot noir.

item.name: Will Rounds Live at Peppers Moonah Links Resort
item.description: Settle into the weekend with Acoustic Friday in the Spike Bar at Moonah Links. From 5pm to 8pm each Saturday, enjoy the sounds of talented local acoustic artists in a relaxed and welcoming setting.

item.description: Located in the Mornington Industrial Estate, Tar Barrel Brewery and Distillery produce award-winning craft beers alongside diverse tastes as part of their whiskey and gin distillery. Enjoy a drink, taste the menu and stay for the live music on weekends!

item.description: Hear journalist and author Jane Gilmore discuss her new book, helping adults talk to kids about consent, relationships and online life.

item.description: Each weekend at Jetty Road Brewery you can enjoy brews and bites, accompanied by local artists playing cool tunes. Full menu available from 12pm, Ben Smith will be live from 6pm.

item.description: Taste and purchase wines while enjoying a guided tour of Elgee Park’s sculpture collection. Starts 12pm.

item.description: Delicious, Festive, Exciting! The festive season is the best time to showcase our fabulous seafood and this class introduces you to a myriad of new ideas and flavours, perfect for your holiday table and picnics and gatherings throughout the summer.

item.name: Dave Campbell Live at Peninsula Beer Garden
item.description: Live Music at Peninsula Beer Garden! Join Dave Campbell for your music fix.

item.name: Olivia Mae Live at Jetty Road Brewery
item.description: Live music every weekend at Jetty Road Brewery! Settle in with a cold craft brew, delicious food and the sounds of talented local artists bringing the brewery to life every weekend.

item.name: "Nancye Wynne Bolton" OLA Golf Day 2026
item.description: A golf-and-lunch day for Old Lauristonians and the wider Lauriston community at Sorrento Golf Club on Monday 30 November. Choose 18 holes, 9 holes or lunch only; golf places are limited and registration is required for every option.

item.name: Pub Carols at The Pig & Whistle
item.description: A group carols night with a live band and two-course meal at The Pig & Whistle in Main Ridge. The organiser lists Thursday 3, 10 and 17 December, each from 6pm to 10pm.

item.name: Mornington Christmas Series at Mornington Racecourse
item.description: Mornington Christmas Series, presented by Barmah Park Vineyard This December, swap the office Christmas party for an afternoon at the races with the Mornington Christmas Series, presented by Barmah Park Vineyard.

item.name: An Evening at BRASA by Montalto
item.description: BRASA brings the spirit of South America to the Mornington Peninsula! A celebration of fire, flavour, theatre and the joy of gathering around the table.

item.name: Coco Michelle Live at Peppers Moonah Links Resort
item.description: Moonah Links is proud to have Coco Michelle performing live this Saturday on the Spike Terrace! Playing from 5pm - 8pm, come along and try the new midweek menu, and listen to some chill live music.

item.name: Countdown Classics 70's & 80's Live at Peninsula Beer Garden
item.description: Countdown Classics, The Ultimate 70’s and 80’s Live Music Experience Get ready for an unforgettable night where you travel back to the 70’s and 80’s, a time that defined music, fashion, and fun. Feel the funk, groove the disco, and sing along to the rock anthems that rocked the world.

item.name: Deck the Chocolate Tree
item.description: Decorate a milk couverture Christmas Tree with delicious ingredients. Starts 9am.

item.name: Deck the Chocolate Tree at The Chocolateries Mornington Peninsula
item.description: Looking for a truly sweet experience this Christmas? Create the wonder of your own Christmas Chocolate Tree at The Chocolateries Mornington Peninsula. Starts 9am.

item.description: Gareth Sansom is a pioneering and highly influential figure in Australian contemporary art, a restless innovator whose career spans more than six decades since his first exhibition at 19 years old in 1959. item.name: The Mount Martha Briars Market
item.description: Situated at one of the Mornington Peninsula’s most beloved and iconic locations, the upcoming Briars Craft and Produce Market will no doubt be a lovely family day out.

item.name: Sunday Sessions: Pottery Workshops at Peachy Keen Ceramics
item.description: New to clay or returning to it? You're in good hands. Starts 3pm.

item.name: The Creators Network: End of Year Catch-up for Creatives
item.description: Come along to meet other MP creatives, join a curator tour of the new Gareth Samson exhibition and hear from a talented local artist.

item.name: James Vincent Live at Fenian Wines
item.description: There will be live music by James Vincent and amazing catering by Three Little Chefs. Enjoy a weekend for all the family, great wine, delicious food and live music all in the relaxed space of Fenian Wines.

item.name: "Whippy" Griggs Live for a Crackin' Night at The Ranch
item.description: World-renowned whip artist Nathan “Whippy” Griggs brings his Aussie Tour to The Ranch! Based in the Northern Territory, Nathan combines incredible whip-cracking skills, handcrafted whips and a healthy dose of good ol' Aussie humour.

item.name: Legends Of Sunbury: Spectrum, Madder Lake & Phil Manning Live at The Pig & Whistle Tavern
item.description: Featuring the cream of Australian Artists Sunbury was touted as “The Rock Happening of its time”. SUNBURY POP FESTIVAL 72’ to 75’ was often regarded as a major milestone in Australian Music history.

item.name: Mornington Twilight Christmas Series at Mornington Racecourse
item.description: Mornington Twilight, presented by Barmah Park Make the most of a summer evening at Mornington Twilight, presented by Barmah Park Vineyard, on Wednesday 16 December.

item.name: Soul Night Market at Hastings Foreshore
item.description: Soul Night Market lights up your Friday nights this summer with a warm, vibrant atmosphere. Wander through a curated mix of makers and food stalls, grab a drink from the bar, and settle to watch spectacular sunsets and listen to Live Soul Music.

item.name: Tony J King Live at Fenian Wines
item.description: There will be live music by Tony J King Food and catering by Brothl Ramen. Enjoy a weekend for all the family, great wine, delicious food and live music all in the relaxed space of Fenian Wines.

item.name: Twilight Mornington Racecourse Market
item.description: The market serves as a regular meeting place for both locals and visitors, showcasing the best that the Mornington Peninsula has to offer. This makers market features handmade, home-made, home-grown, or Australian-designed items.

item.name: Eve Eve at Portsea Hotel
item.description: A pre-Christmas night of live music and DJs at the Portsea Hotel, with Sarah Roberts, Minx, Tiff Cornish and Some Sheila playing from 5pm to 11pm. Strictly 18+.

item.name: Celebrate Christmas Day at Peppers Moonah Links Resort
item.description: Join us for a relaxed and memorable Christmas Day lunch at Peppers Moonah Links Resort, with our festive buffet feast returning for another year.

item.name: Christmas Day at Ember
item.description: Gather the family and celebrate Christmas Day in Ember, with a 12pm sitting for a relaxed afternoon of festive dining.

item.name: Christmas Day Feast at The Conti
item.description: The Continental Sorrento hosts Christmas Day lunch in Halcyon Hall, the Grand Ballroom and CeeCee’s. The shared feast includes seafood and charcuterie, followed by Christmas ham, sirloin and barramundi. The organiser lists an 11:30am sitting in Halcyon Hall and the Grand Ballroom, and a 1pm sitting at CeeCee’s; check the venue for current booking details.

item.name: Celebrate with Andrew Farrell Live at Fenian Wines
item.description: Let’s wrap up the year in true Fenian style! Join us at Fenian Wines for our traditional end of year celebration on the last Sunday of 2026.

item.name: The Mount Martha Briars Twilight Market
item.description: Situated at one of the Mornington Peninsula’s most beloved and iconic locations, the upcoming Briars Craft and Produce Market will no doubt be a lovely family day out.

item.name: New Year's Eve at Orson
item.description: Join us for New Year’s Eve at Orson, with two special sittings celebrating the best of the season, each beginning with a glass of Sparkling on arrival. Choose our early sitting from 5:30 - 8pm, featuring a five-course menu and designed for those heading on to celebrations later in the evening.

item.name: New Year’s Eve at Portsea Hotel
item.description: New Year's Eve by the water at the Portsea Hotel, with Kayla Bruno and Holmes John from 5pm, then Piero and singer Karina Chavez headlining from 10pm through the midnight countdown. Strictly 18+.

item.name: New Years Eve Event 2026/2027
item.description: A four-course New Year's Eve dinner at The Baths Sorrento, with a cocktail on arrival, drinks through the night and a DJ, from 7.30pm until just after midnight. Over-18s only.

item.name: NYE at Barlow
item.description: MEET US ON THE DANCE FLOOR THIS NEW YEAR’S EVE Gather your crew for great drinks, dancing and celebrations from 9pm until late. Whether you’re heading in after dinner or making Barlow your destination for the night, join us for the countdown and keep the celebrations going into 2027. Starts 9pm.

item.name: NYE Casa Conti
item.description: Casa Conti: Midnight in Ibiza This New Year’s Eve, we’re bringing the magic of Ibiza to Sorrento. Step into Casa Conti: Midnight in Ibiza, where Mediterranean glamour meets the energy of Europe’s most iconic party destination. Starts 8pm.

item.name: New Year's Day at Mornington Racecourse
item.description: Mornington New Year's Day Ring in the New Year in style with us, trackside at Mornington Racecourse. Set up your lawn chairs on the rolling green hills with family or friends and bring the kids along for the first Clip Clop Club race day of the year.

item.name: Peninsula Summer Music Festival: Charlotte Miles at Port Phillip Estate
item.description: A solo cello takes centre stage at Port Phillip Estate as Charlotte Miles presents a recital exploring the instrument’s remarkable range.

item.name: Peninsula Film Festival at Rosebud Cinema
item.description: The Peninsula Film Festival is Mornington Peninsula's iconic film festival running across three days in January. The Festival kicks off with a launch and feature film screening on Friday Jan 8 at Rosebud Cinema 7pm, followed by a Q&A and nibbles and drinks.

item.description: THIS ONE'S FOR THE KIDS! Get ready for five action-packed days at Summer Camp, Designed for young adventurers aged 7-14, campers will spend the week exploring, learning new skills and making new friends while experiencing an exciting mix of outdoor adventures. Starts 9.30am.

item.description: Torren Foot headlines a summer session at the Portsea Hotel, after house sets from Jake Webb, Bella Backe and Airwolf Paradise from 5pm. His own set runs from 9.30pm to 11pm. Strictly 18+.
